title: ジャパンCの後に・そして、タイマンへ

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Yeeeaaah!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff…

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: So that's how it is…

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Hishi Amazon, Queen of the Amazons, claims a stunning victory at the Japan Cup!
Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Whoa, that was an incredible run! It was so amazing, it gave me goosebumps.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Hey, look at Narita Brian… Her expression is super intense…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I did it, Teach!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hehe, thanks! But man, there's really only one opponent for me—
We're interrupted before Hishi Amazon can finish her sentence.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Ama.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hey, Brian! Great timing. I was just talking about you!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Today, I brought my A game, and fought past some real tough racers. But winning just didn't feel like enough.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: It's not the same without you. You're the only rival for me.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I'll be waiting for ya, so get on my level already.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …Yeah, no need to tell me twice.
The glint in Narita Brian's eyes is as keen and fierce as a beast's.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …All this time, I've been chasing my sister's shadow. Waking or dreaming, her back is all I can see.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: But I've never been able to catch up—and that divide between us has stoked a feverish blaze in me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Today… I felt that fire watching you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I will definitely surpass you the next time we meet. I won't let you win the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Oooh! So that's how you feel!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I knew it!
Next up is finally the Arima Kinen!
